name: tabbed-tab-lead
title: SOT-223 and SOT-89 package
summary: Small-outline transistor package: a transfer-moulded body on its standoff in two drafted halves meeting at the parting line where the leads leave, its corners and top edges rounded, with a −y row of bent gull-wing leads and a wide tab lead on +y; matte-tin leads; a marking-top surface on the top face (pitch, body_length, body_width, body_height, standoff, span, lead_width, lead_thickness, foot_length and the rows' counts and steps; draft, rounds and marking area derived).
provenance: Original work, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored`, at the SOT-223 starter values; the tabbed generator gives every input its value. The moulding follows Microchip's 8-lead SOIC drawing C04-057 (mould draft 5–15° top and bottom, optional pin-1 chamfer h 0.25–0.50 mm) and Fairchild/onsemi's SOIC drawings (pin-1 bevel edge as option A); rounds and lead bends are estimated. Looked at, never copied: the manufacturers' photographs and package drawings cited; no vendor drawing, CAD model or EDA library data copied.
